elgato.lights.list.description: Lists every Elgato light Cuebot knows, like a Key Light or Light Strip.
elgato.lights.list.returns: A list of lights. Each has deviceId, deviceName, productName, serialNumber, ipAddress, port and online. Lights that answered also have on, brightness, temperature (Kelvin), hue and saturation.

elgato.lights.isRunning.description: Checks whether Cuebot is watching your Elgato lights right now.
elgato.lights.isRunning.returns: true while Cuebot checks your lights, otherwise false.

elgato.lights.start.description: Starts looking for Elgato lights on your network and watching them. It starts over if it was already running.

elgato.lights.discover.description: Looks for Elgato lights on your network right now.
elgato.lights.discover.returns: A list of the lights that were found (same details as elgato.lights.list).

elgato.lights.add.description: Adds an Elgato light by its network address. Handy when Cuebot does not find it on its own. Fails with an error when the light cannot be reached.

parameters.address: The light's IP address, like "192.168.1.50". You can add a port, like "192.168.1.50:9123". Find it in the Elgato Control Center app.

elgato.lights.add.returns: The light that was added, with the same details as elgato.lights.list.

elgato.lights.setPower.description: Turns Elgato lights on or off. Fails with an error when no light matches.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address. Split several with commas. "All" or empty means every light.
parameters.state: Optional. "On", "Off" or "Toggle" (switch to the other one). Default "Toggle".

elgato.lights.setPower.returns: A list of the lights that changed, with their new details.

elgato.lights.setBrightness.description: Changes how bright Elgato lights are. Fails with an error when no light matches.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address. Split several with commas. "All" or empty means every light.
parameters.adjust: Optional. true adds the number to the current brightness instead (use a minus number to dim). Default false.

elgato.lights.setBrightness.returns: A list of the lights that changed, with their new details.

elgato.lights.setTemperature.description: Changes the colour warmth of Elgato lights, from warm yellow to cool white. Fails with an error when no light matches.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address. Split several with commas. "All" or empty means every light.
parameters.temperature: The warmth in Kelvin, 2900 (warm) to 7000 (cool), like 4500.
parameters.adjust: Optional. true adds the Kelvin number to the current value instead. Default false.

elgato.lights.setTemperature.returns: A list of the lights that changed, with their new details.

elgato.lights.setColor.description: Changes the colour of Elgato lights that can show colours, like the Light Strip. Fails with an error when no light matches.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address. Split several with commas. "All" or empty means every light.
parameters.hue: The colour, 0-360 around the colour wheel: 0 red, 120 green, 240 blue.
parameters.saturation: How strong the colour is, 0-100. 0 is white, 100 is full colour.

elgato.lights.setColor.returns: A list of the lights that changed, with their new details.

elgato.lights.identify.description: Makes Elgato lights blink, so you can see which one is which. Fails with an error when no light matches.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address. Split several with commas. "All" or empty means every light.

elgato.lights.rename.description: Gives an Elgato light a new name. The name is saved on the light itself, so Control Center shows it too.

parameters.device: Which light: its name, id or IP address.
parameters.name: The new name, like "Desk Light".

elgato.cameraHub.isAvailable.description: Checks whether Cuebot can control webcam settings on this computer. Right now this works on Linux.
elgato.cameraHub.isAvailable.returns: true when webcam control works here, otherwise false.

elgato.cameraHub.webcams.description: Lists your webcams and their current picture settings.
elgato.cameraHub.webcams.returns: A list of webcams. Each has deviceId, deviceName, devicePath and the settings it supports, like brightness, contrast, focus, zoomValue, autoFocus, antiFlicker, mirrored and flipped.

elgato.cameraHub.set.description: Changes one picture setting on your webcam, like brightness or zoom. Fails with an error when the webcam or setting is not found.

parameters.device: Which webcam: its name, id or device path. Empty means the first webcam. "All" means every webcam.
parameters.control: The setting: brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, focus, pan, tilt, whiteBalance, zoom, autoFocus, autoWhiteBalance, autoExposure, antiFlicker, mirror or flip.
parameters.value: The new value as a number, like 60. Zoom is 100-400 percent. On/off settings take 1 (on) or 0 (off). antiFlicker also takes "Off", "50 Hz", "60 Hz" or "Auto".
parameters.adjust: Optional. true adds the value to the current one instead. Default false.

elgato.cameraHub.set.returns: The new value of the setting (from the first webcam).

elgato.studio.isRunning.description: Checks whether the Elgato Studio app is open on this computer. Cuebot can only see it; Elgato Studio has no way to be controlled.
elgato.studio.isRunning.returns: true while Elgato Studio is running, otherwise false.
